Tickets

Benidorm

Sunday 17 January 2027

In mid-January, the UCI Cyclo-cross World Cup swaps mud for sun and sand. On Sunday 17 January, the riders will battle for the win in Benidorm, Spain. Last year, Lucinda Brand and Mathieu van der Poel raced to victory on the Costa Blanca. Who will be the fastest under the Spanish sun this year?

Tickets

Would you like to be there in Benidorm on Sunday 17 January? Click the button below and order your tickets now!

Ticket prices:

  • Presale:
    • Until 15 November inclusive: €19
    • 16 November – 6 January: €22
    • 7 January – 16 January (14:00 CET): €25
  • On the day of the races: €25
  • Children born after 1 January 2013: €2

 

GO TO THE TICKET SHOP

How to get there?

By train

Take the Tram Metropolità d'Alacant. Line 1 takes you from Alicante to Benidorm Station. From there, it's just a few hundred metres' walk to the course. Line 9 runs from Dénia to Benidorm Intermodal, which is about 1.5 km from the course. You can find more information here.

 

By car

Parking is available at one of Benidorm's free car parks. You can find more information here.
